item.cable.name: Logistics Cable
item.cable.description: Carries a storage network between tiles. Any chest touching a cable joins the network.
item.terminal.name: Storage Terminal
item.terminal.description: Browse, search and withdraw everything stored on the network from one screen.
item.crafting-terminal.name: Crafting Terminal
item.crafting-terminal.description: A storage terminal that can also craft using materials held anywhere on the network.
item.import-bus.name: Import Bus
item.import-bus.description: Pulls items out of the chest or machine beside it and onto the network.
item.export-bus.name: Export Bus
item.export-bus.description: Pushes filtered items from the network into the chest or machine beside it.
sort.name: Name
ui.filter-hint: Click to filter, right-click to clear.
ui.stored-count: {{count}} in storage. Click for a stack, right-click for one, shift-click to fill your bag.
ui.click-to-store: Click to store. Shift-click to store every stack of this item.
ui.no-results: Nothing on the network matches that search.
ui.no-storage: No chests are connected. Put a chest next to a cable to get started.
ui.no-devices: No chests or buses are attached to this network yet.
ui.priority-hint: Insertion priority. Higher fills first and drains last. Right-click to step by ten.
ui.mode-hint: Switch between storing only the listed items and storing everything except them.
ui.filter-set-hint: Click, then pick an item from your bag to add it to this filter.
ui.filter-clear-hint: Click to remove this item from the filter.
ui.pick-filter-item: Pick an item from your bag to add it to the filter.
ui.recipe-learned: You worked out how to build a {{name}}!
error.not-connected: This terminal isn't connected to a cable.
error.terminal-failed: The terminal couldn't open. Check the SMAPI log for details.
error.network-full: The network has nowhere to put that.
config.bus-interval.name: Bus interval (ticks)
config.bus-interval.tooltip: How often import and export buses run. 60 ticks is one second.
config.bus-rate.name: Items per bus run
config.bus-rate.tooltip: The most items a single bus moves each time it runs.
config.machines.name: Automate machines
config.machines.tooltip: Let buses collect finished machine output and load raw materials in.
config.recipes.name: Unlock all recipes
config.recipes.tooltip: Teach every logistics recipe immediately instead of gating them behind Mining levels.
config.terminal-key.name: Open terminal key
config.terminal-key.tooltip: An optional key that opens the terminal under your cursor.
